cv2.reason: Several OpenCV builds provide cv2; rank picks the headless build, but opencv-python is the reference distribution.

opentelemetry.sdk.reason: opentelemetry-sdk ships opentelemetry/sdk/__init__.pyi but no __init__.py, so the generator sees an implicit namespace and only maps its subpackages.

pkg_resources.reason: Provided by older setuptools releases; recent wheels no longer ship it, so the generator cannot see it.

win32con.reason: pywin32 installs this module through a .pth path at install time; it is not a top-level entry in the wheel.
